kobeni.description: Dash beside target and deliver 3 strikes totaling 240% AD physical damage. Gain 20% damage reduction for 1s.
kobeni.name: Kobeni Higashiyama

makima.description: After 0.6s, control the highest-AD eligible enemy for 2s. It fights its former team, can critically strike, trigger equipment, generate mana and cast skills. Its basic attacks deal 75% of their normal damage, multiplied by Blue's ability power, with no attack-count cap. Skills and equipment use the victim's normal stats. Afterward it cannot be controlled again for 5s. Bosses, immune targets or a lone enemy instead take (220S + 150% AD) magic damage and lose 20% AD for 4s. No stun.
makima.name: Blue

frenzy_boar.description: Tusk Charge: deals 200% attack physical damage to one target.
frenzy_boar.name: Frenzy Boar

yuji.description: Strike for 180% AD physical damage; 0.4s later deal (60S + 80% AD) magic damage to the same surviving target.
yuji.name: Yuji Itadori

tatara.description: Channel a locked forward cone for 2s, dealing (70S + 60% AD) magic damage every 0.5s, up to four hits. Hard interruption ends the channel.
tatara.name: Tatara

shoko.description: Heal the lowest-HP% ally for (160S + 80% AD), cleanse one removable debuff, and grant 10% damage reduction for 3s.
shoko.name: Shoko Ieiri

reze.description: First cast: transform into Bomb Devil form and detonate within 1 hex of self for (45S + 75% AD) magic damage. Later casts: throw three bombs for that damage each, with half damage to adjacent enemies. Remaining bombs retarget a living enemy in range if their victim dies. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
reze.name: Reze

lizardman_lord.description: Scimitar Sweep: deals 160% attack physical damage around the target.
lizardman_lord.name: Lizardman Lord

yuuki.description: Strike ten times for 20% AD physical damage each, then thrust for 150% AD Ã— (1 + 2 Ã— the target's missing-health fraction).
yuuki.name: Yuuki

arima.description: Alternate Lance: 240% AD physical, 50% to one enemy behind; Guard: 150S shield for 4s, counter next basic attacker within 2 hexes for 180% AD physical. Starts with Lance.
arima.name: Kisho Arima

yoshimura.description: After a 1s wind-up, bombard a marked hex for (100S + 200% AD) physical damage. Enemies on adjacent hexes take 60% damage.
yoshimura.name: Yoshimura

aki.description: Fox bite deals (120S + 150% AD) magic damage and stuns target 0.6s. Adjacent enemies take 40% damage, no stun.
aki.name: Aki Hayakawa

kaneki.description: First cast: transform, +20% maximum HP (restore added HP), 10% direct-damage healing (one-third for area damage). Later: frontal cone for 300% AD physical damage and heal 5% maximum HP. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
kaneki.name: Ken Sabrina

yuta.description: Heal lowest-HP% ally for (180S + 120% AD), shield for 120S for 4s, then strike current enemy for 140% AD magic damage.
yuta.name: Yuta Okkotsu

denji.description: First cast: transform, +20% maximum HP (restore added HP), +20% attack speed. Later casts: 300% AD physical damage and 30% reduced healing for 4s. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
denji.name: Denji

erwin.description: Rally allies within 2 hexes, including Erwin, granting 20% bonus AD and 25% attack speed for 5s.
erwin.name: Erwin Smith

reiner.description: First cast: transform, +20% maximum HP (restore added HP), +20 armor. Later: 18% maximum-HP shield for 4s and 150% AD physical strike. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
reiner.name: Reiner Braun

gleam_eyes.description: After a 1-second wind-up, slashes a 120° forward cone up to 2 hexes deep for 170% attack physical damage. Direction locks at the start of the wind-up.
gleam_eyes.name: The Gleam Eyes

sinon.description: After 0.8s, shoot toward farthest enemy within 4 hexes. First hit: 350% AD physical; next 2 take 60%. Ignores 20% armor.
sinon.name: Sinon

megumi.description: Two spectral bites, each (70S + 90% AD) magic damage. Second bite reduces armor and MR by 20% for 5s.
megumi.name: Megumi Fushiguro

levi.description: Dash beside lowest-HP% enemy within 3 hexes; 6 slashes over 1.2s total 420% AD physical damage. 30% damage reduction during channel; not invulnerable.
levi.name: Brock Ackerman

illfang.description: After a 1-second wind-up, deals 160% attack physical damage to his target and 80% to other enemies within 1 hex of that target. Stuns the primary target for 0.6 seconds.
illfang.name: Illfang the Kobold Lord

katana_man.description: After a brief draw stance, dash through the target for 300% AD physical damage. Up to two other enemies on the path take half damage.
katana_man.name: Katana Man

panda.description: Shield self for 18% maximum HP and gain 15% damage reduction for 4s. Strike for 160% AD physical damage; adjacent enemies take half damage.
panda.name: Panda

armin.description: First cast: transform into the Colossal Titan after 1s and erupt with steam within 2 hexes of self, dealing 60% of the normal blast damage. Later casts: after 1s, explode within 1 hex of target for (180S + 120% AD) magic damage. Both blasts slow attack speed by 20% for 3s. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
armin.name: Armin Arlert

mikasa.description: Dash through target to free hex behind it: 280% AD physical damage; up to 2 others on path take 50%. +20% attack speed for 3s. Strike in place if blocked.
mikasa.name: Mikasa Ackerman

asuna.description: Dash beside target for 260% AD physical damage; +25% attack speed for 3s (refreshes).
asuna.name: Asuna

ayato.description: Hop to a safe firing position and launch three feathers for 70% AD physical damage each. Gain 35% attack speed for 4s.
ayato.name: Ayato Kirishima

kirito.description: Channel 8 slashes over 1.6s, totaling 600% AD physical damage. Remaining slashes transfer to an adjacent enemy if the target dies. Interrupted by stun.
kirito.name: Misty

eugeo.description: Send ice through a 4-hex line, dealing (180S + 150% AD) magic damage to each enemy hit and rooting them for 1.5s.
eugeo.name: Eugeo

heathcliff.description: Gain a (300S + 80% AD) shield for 4s. Adjacent allies gain 20% damage reduction for 4s.
heathcliff.name: Heathcliff

eren.description: First cast: transform, +25% maximum HP (restore added HP), +20% AD. Later: frontal cone for 260% AD physical damage and 0.75s stun. After transforming, multiply the listed ability damage by 1.25.
eren.name: Eren Yeager

lisbeth.description: Shield self for 18% maximum HP for 4s. Up to 2 adjacent lowest-HP% allies receive half that shield.
lisbeth.name: Lisbeth

amon.description: Gain a 16% maximum-HP shield and +15 armor for 4s. Strike current target for 170% AD physical damage.
amon.name: Koutaro Amon

kobold_sentinel.description: Mace Smash: deals 200% attack physical damage to one target. Stuns for 0.5 seconds.
kobold_sentinel.name: Ruin Kobold Sentinel

touka.description: Distribute 5 shards evenly across up to 3 nearest enemies within 3 hexes, extras nearest first. Each deals (25S + 65% AD) magic damage.
touka.name: Touka Kirishima

power.description: Slam for 220% AD physical damage; adjacent enemies take 60%. Gain a 12% maximum-HP shield for 4s.
power.name: Power

himeno.description: A ghost hand stuns an enemy for 0.8s and reduces its AD by 20% for 4s. Shield the lowest-HP% ally for (120S + 60% AD) for 4s.
himeno.name: Himeno

akane.description: Summon a serpent to strike the enemy with the highest mana percentage within 3 hexes for (180S + 120% AD) magic damage and silence them for 1.5s.
akane.name: Akane Sawatari

juuzou.description: Four strikes total 360% AD physical damage. First applies 20% armor reduction for 4s; later strikes benefit.
juuzou.name: Juuzou Suzuya

leafa.description: Heal the two lowest-HP% allies within 3 hexes for (160S + 80% AD) each and grant them 25% attack speed for 4s.
leafa.name: Leafa

kenny.description: Grapple to a safe flank that preserves shooting distance, then fire two shots at one enemy for 140% AD physical damage each.
kenny.name: Kenny Ackerman

sasha.description: Focus for up to 6s. Against one target, the first two basic attacks deal normal damage; the third deals 300% AD instead of its normal damage.
sasha.name: Sasha Blouse

nobara.description: Deal (100S + 100% AD) magic damage. Mark for 4s: next 3 basic attacks against that target add 35S magic damage.
nobara.name: Nobara Kugisaki

gojo.description: After 0.8s, fire a line through the target: (350S + 200% AD) magic damage; each enemy pierced reduces damage by 15 percentage points, minimum 55%.
gojo.name: Satoru Red

skull_reaper.description: Locks onto an enemy with no adjacent allies, preferring the farthest eligible unit; otherwise chooses the farthest enemy. After a 0.6-second wind-up, lunges to a free adjacent hex and deals 150% attack physical damage.
skull_reaper.name: The Skull Reaper

nanami.description: Strike for 200% AD physical damage and mark until cleansed or defeated. Nanami deals 30% more direct damage to marked targets. Recasts deal 300% AD physical damage and stun for 0.5s.
nanami.name: Kento Nanami

silica.description: Heal lowest-HP% ally for (140S + 80% AD). Grant +15 armor and MR for 4s (refreshes).
silica.name: Silica

hinami.description: Shield the two lowest-HP% allies within 3 hexes for (180S + 80% AD) for 4s. Enemies adjacent to those allies lose 20% attack speed for 4s.
hinami.name: Hinami Fueguchi
